items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 93:1
items.html: For besides the difference of covered Chasadim that exists between AVI and Yisrael Saba ve Tevuna, as is known, there is yet another difference in this matter between Aba Ila’ah and Ima Ila’ah themselves. For the root of Aba Ila’ah — that is, his two and a half Chasadim — remained sealed within the Yesod of Atik. But the roots of the Gevurot of Ima Ila’ah went out from the Yesod of Atik and were revealed in the HGT of AA, as the ARI writes in Etz Chaim, Gate 14, end of Chapter 1; see there. And on this his words here revolve: that after the breaking open of the Yesod of Atik, the two and a half Chasadim of Aba were also revealed outward, and now there is no longer any difference between Aba Ila’ah and Ima Ila’ah. (p. 920, Item 89)
